<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/metastationapi/socialTrade/webhook/{webhookSecret}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Send a trading signal to execute on the account slot that owns the
webhook secret in the URL. Accepts JSON, or natural language as
text/plain (or inside a \{"message": "..."\} wrapper).

Copy the exact URL from Automation -&gt; Your Webhook URLs rather than
assembling it by hand.

A 200 means the signal was accepted and QUEUED, not that the order
filled. Confirm real state from your positions or History -&gt; Signal
History. The same request repeated within 60 seconds runs once and is
answered with "replay": true.

Add ?dryRun=1 (or an X-Dry-Run: 1 header, or "dryRun": true) to get
the orders the signal would place without placing anything.
